name: The 86 system
description: A short tutorial kitchen for the 86 system: an onion crate, a tomato crate that runs out, and a delivery door beside them.
strategy: Empty the tomato crate, watch the ticket rewrite itself, unload the delivery at the door, then serve either soup.

tutorial.title: When the crate runs dry
intro: Every crate holds a set number of items and shows its fill level. Taking the last one empties it: an 86, chalked over the crate.
Tickets never vanish. One that needed the missing ingredient rewrites itself to the nearest dish still on the menu, with a flash and a sting.
Work already done is never wasted: a dish built to the old ticket still serves and still pays.
A delivery arrives at the door after a while. Unload it with a held {interact}; a second chef makes it twice as fast.
At most two ingredients are ever out at once, and one used in every recipe on a level never runs out.

steps.text: Take three tomatoes from the crate. The last one empties it: a chalk 86 goes up and the fill bar hits red.
The tomato soup ticket just rewrote itself to onion soup with a flash and now wears an 86 tag. A tomato soup built to the old ticket still serves.
A delivery is on its way to the door. When the crate appears there, face it and hold {interact} to unload it. Two chefs unload twice as fast.
Serve a soup. The rewritten ticket pays for onion soup, or for the tomato soup it used to ask for.

tutorial.outro: Crates only run out with the 86 switch on. Crate size and the delivery delay are set per level.
